discovery.title: Strategies to ensure DEI workforce safeguards in hospitality and tourism
discovery.summary: While right-leaning governments around the world are railing against workforce diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI) measures that have been in place for over two decades, researchers note that the diversity of staff within hospitality and tourism businesses around the world—and the diverse customers they serve—requires a strong DEI framework to best serve these industries.
